plugins.name: 3D Codeblocks
plugins.description: Render 3D artifacts (GLB, glTF, STL) inline from a code block — orbit, zoom and pan without leaving your note.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: AnySource Sideloader
plugins.description: Install and update plugins from any git forge (GitHub, Forgejo, Gitea, raw URLs) with subscribable catalogs.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Health Vitals
plugins.description: Import Apple Health exports and explore your health data in charts and tables.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Audio Interface
plugins.description: Read notes aloud with system voices, export them as WAV with downloadable German or English voices, and turn audio files in your vault into text. No cloud, no account.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Calendar and Contact Notes
plugins.description: Mirror CalDAV events and CardDAV contacts as notes; the server stays the source of truth.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: EPUB Exporter
plugins.description: Export a note — or a book note with embedded chapters — as an EPUB.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Image to Markdown
plugins.description: Transcribe images and PDFs in a note to Markdown with a local vision LLM — fully offline, non-destructive, streaming into the sidebar.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: JSON Editor
plugins.description: View and edit JSON and JSONC files in a tree or source view. Comments and formatting in JSONC survive editing. Renders JSON code blocks in Markdown notes.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Koda
plugins.description: Agentic vault companion: chat with an assistant that searches and reads your notes, writes only with your approval, and learns through a transparent memory note.
plugins.author: Jay

plugins.name: Kuro Gamification
plugins.description: Neurodivergence-friendly gamification: XP, levels, streaks with freeze tokens, deterministic loot, and lore. Off-by-default for anything that could escalate.
plugins.author: Jay

plugins.name: LLM Lab
plugins.description: Record the local LLM calls your plugins make — stored only inside your vault.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Local Image Generator
plugins.description: Generate images right in your vault — built-in SD-Turbo on your GPU, or your local Draw Things / A1111 server. Private, on-device, no cloud.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Mailstone
plugins.description: Mail as vault notes: a server-side folder decides what becomes a note. Sends iMIP invitations for calendar-notes.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Slide Deck
plugins.description: Turn a Markdown note into a slide deck and export it to PDF or a PNG image series, with live readability checks.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Letterhead
plugins.description: Generate professionally formatted business letters (DIN 5008 and modern) from note frontmatter and export them to PDF — via the print dialog on desktop, or the system share sheet on iPhone and iPad.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Paperize
plugins.description: Export the active note as a clean, text-selectable vector PDF — just the note's content. Works on desktop, iPhone and iPad.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Transmute
plugins.description: Search and replace by intent — a local LLM writes the regex, you review every match before it runs.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Paperless Storage
plugins.description: Embed documents from your paperless-ngx instance directly in your notes.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Vault Crews
plugins.description: Run autonomous local LLM agent teams (crews) on your vault via LM Studio.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Vault Retrieval
plugins.description: On-device retrieval over your vault — related notes, semantic search — plus grounded chat with the LLM endpoint you configure.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: NeuroVim
plugins.description: Learn Vim by playing a cyberpunk spy-thriller. Missions are Vim exercises you fix in real notes.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl

plugins.name: Wiki.js Maintainer
plugins.description: Publish and sync notes from a folder of your vault to a Wiki.js 2.x instance over GraphQL, with drift detection before every push.
plugins.author: Jay

plugins.name: Yijing Oracle
plugins.description: Cast the I Ching (Yijing) in your vault: three-coin oracle with Wilhelm hexagram texts, readings saved as notes. Local-first, no cloud.
plugins.author: Johannes Kaindl
